title: Concavity in the additional squared length
statement: For any $m\ge 0$, profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, real numbers $a,b$, and vectors $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, the function $c\mapsto L(1,c)$ is concave on $[0,\infty)$.
replaced: For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. For every $P,a,b,u,v$, the function $c\mapsto L(1,c)$ is concave on $[0,\infty)$.
